# lahja

> Find the user-facing strings AI code tools hardcode instead of translating. Formerly i18nlint.

lahja is a CLI + MCP server (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) that scans React / Next / Vue /
Svelte / Astro / HTML and reports every user-facing string that isn't translated yet — hardcoded
JSX/markup text, hardcoded string literals (const label = '...', alert('...'), toast(`...`)),
placeholder/alt/title/aria-label attributes, un-localized dates & currency, and a missing
`<html lang>`. Detection is AST-verified (Babel), so live code and dynamic bindings are never
mistaken for UI text.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/i18nlint .` (binary: `lahja`, alias `i18nlint`)
- MCP: run `lahja-mcp` (tools: lahja_scan, lahja_check_code)
- AI rules: `lahja --init-rules` writes I18N-RULES.md
- Legacy adoption: `lahja . --baseline` accepts current debt, fails only on NEW strings

## Rules for agents
Wrap every user-facing string in the project's t()/translation function; localize placeholder/
alt/title/aria-label; use Intl.DateTimeFormat / Intl.NumberFormat with a locale; set <html lang>.

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/i18nlint · https://dev.ottospace.co
